title: Evergreen inventory v1
description: What one or more export files say is running, and the lifecycle check for each item. Every item names the export file and the exact pointer its claim rests on.

unrecognized.description: Files no importer recognized, or that could not be read, as given.

file.description: The export file as given on the command line.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the version value; for a text export, line:<n>.

resource.description: The resource's own name. Never an account id, ARN, or secret.

purl.description: Version-less canonical Package URL the lifecycle rules are written against.
